note: z1-m1-correct-1116 (RUN FIRST, before z1-m1-timing-1116; NOT RUN): docs/275 Z1 zdemptyout + M1 decaymemo correctness and Z1 empty-table probe, BP + IP, 10 min each, Bin state apex (apex-rewind when the chain has it; the two jobs differ in save, so each starts fresh). Its Z1 probe decides whether the timing queue runs for Z1 at all. Build ts3fixes.z1-m1-1116 + ts3agent.z1-m1-1116 (builds.json, branch feature/z1-m1-inplace-1116 on master 6b872296f) over the newest registered native pair master-1116b (0.36.266-mb1116, no native change in this lane). AGENT: install game-copy/ts3agent.package.z1-m1-1116 to build/ (or TS3_AGENT_PACKAGE); an older agent lacks the zdemptyout_* / decaymemo_* names and the fixesRequire rules fail as missing. Est ~30 min with loads.

jobs.note: CORRECTNESS + Z1 PROBE (10 min, verify mode on every early-out): Bridgeport. Pass: decaymemo_hits >= 1, decaymemo_mismatches 0, zdemptyout_*_calls >= 1, zdemptyout_mismatches 0, 0 script errors, switches read back (profile 'fixes on: ... (verified)'). Household untouched: both designs are exact for every Sim and lot, so the verify mismatch counters (they cover household and selected Sims, no scope gate) are the household check. Probe to read: zdemptyout_stereo_empty / zdemptyout_stereo_calls (docs/275 §3.1: under 0.8 = park Z1, build Z2 only if the table is rarely empty), decaymemo_hits / (hits + misses), decaymemo_buffadds per minute.
